text: The driver needs help to stay in the lane on long motorway drives.
The driver needs to stay responsible for steering.
The driver needs to be warned before the vehicle leaves the lane by mistake.
The system should keep the vehicle in the lane.
The LKA system shall detect lane markings quickly and reliably.
The LKA system shall warn the driver and/or apply a steering torque when the vehicle leaves the lane.
The corrective steering torque shall be limited to TBD Nm.
The LKA system shall work in all weather conditions such as rain, snow, fog etc.
If possible, the LKA system shall switch off when the driver steers against it.
The LKA system shall react within a short time after it detects a lane departure.
The LKA system shall display its status and shall play a sound when it intervenes.
When the vehicle crosses a lane marking without the turn indicator on, the LKA system shall apply a corrective steering torque of at most 3 Nm.
Drive 50 km on a motorway with LKA active and count lane departures.
Drift over the lane marking at 80 km/h without indicator and log the steering torque.
Measure the maximum steering torque request on the HIL bench.
Steer against the LKA torque with 3 Nm and check that LKA switches off.
Check the LKA icon in the instrument cluster.
